description.zh: Kimi Code CLI：终端 AI 编程 agent——TUI 应用、Rust 引擎、SDK 边界与共享库，绘成一棵分形模块树。

description.zh: Kimi Code 的可交付应用面：CLI/TUI 主程序、编辑器集成、可视化服务与文档站。
description.en: Shippable surfaces of Kimi Code: the CLI/TUI app, editor integrations, visualization and the docs site.

description.zh: 终端主应用：命令解析、TUI 交互、会话编排、斜杠命令与插件面板，经 node-sdk 驱动引擎。
description.en: The terminal app: command parsing, TUI, session orchestration, slash commands and the plugin panel, driving the engine via the node SDK.

description.zh: CLI 管线：commander 程序、子命令、配置与启动错误处理。

description.zh: TUI 外壳：kimi-tui、controllers、dialogs、消息组件与会话事件处理器。
description.en: The TUI shell: kimi-tui, controllers, dialogs, message components and the session event handler.

description.zh: VitePress 文档站：双语用户文档与 Normify 规范页。
description.en: VitePress docs site: bilingual user documentation and the Normify specification page.

description.zh: 会话检查器 Web 应用（React）：activity / audit / channel 面板读取引擎转录。
description.en: Session inspector web app (React): activity, audit and channel panels over the engine transcript.

description.zh: 检查器面板：activity / audit / channel 视图读取会话转录。
description.en: Inspector panels: activity, audit and channel views over the session transcript.

description.zh: 活动视图：会话时间线上的工具调用与回合事件。
description.en: Activity view: tool calls and turn events on the session timeline.

description.zh: 审计视图：权限决策与审批记录，含 diff/truncate/serialize 辅助。
description.en: Audit view: permission decisions and approvals, with diff/truncate/serialize helpers.

description.zh: 信道视图：宿主与引擎之间的原始事件信道（ws 客户端、代理、错误）。
description.en: Channel view: the raw event channels between host and engine (ws client, proxy, errors).

description.zh: 检查器外壳：React 入口、应用根组件与引擎连接上下文。
description.en: Inspector shell: React entry, app root and the engine connection context.

description.zh: 可视化服务：本地 Web 端渲染会话与结构（server + web 前端）。
description.en: Visualization service: local web rendering of sessions and structures (server + web frontend).

description.zh: 编辑器集成：把会话嵌入 VS Code。
description.en: Editor integration: embeds sessions into VS Code.

description.zh: kimi-agent crate：回合循环、会话、工具、MCP、LLM 传输、服务器与插件注册表，编译为 napi 原生模块。
description.en: The kimi-agent crate: turn loop, sessions, tools, MCP, LLM transports, server and the plugin registry, compiled as a napi addon.

description.zh: 引擎核心：run_turn 状态机、会话生命周期、压缩、子代理编排与事件总线。
description.en: Engine core: the run_turn state machine, session lifecycle, compaction, subagent orchestration and the event bus.

description.zh: 上下文压缩：窗口核算、micro 压缩与压缩指令提示词。
description.en: Context compaction: window accounting, micro-compaction and the compaction instruction prompt.

description.zh: 把状态、模式与技能折成 <system-reminder> 注入到步首。注册表是唯一入口，DomainValueSource 是它读领域值的唯一契约。
description.en: Folds state, modes and skills into <system-reminder> at each step head. The registry is the single entry point, and DomainValueSource the one contract it reads domain values through.

description.zh: goal 在新回合注入一次；plan_mode 按 full/sparse/exit 节奏注入，节奏由注入器自己的 turns_since 驱动。
description.en: Goal injects once per new turn; plan_mode injects on a full/sparse/exit cadence driven by the provider's own turns_since.

description.zh: 上一回合被用户中断时，在下一回合步首注入一次性提醒；历史里已有就不再重复。
description.en: A one-shot reminder at the next turn's head when the previous turn was interrupted by the user; suppressed when history already carries one.

description.zh: 权限模式相对基线变化时注入一次，让模型知道当前处于哪种模式。
description.en: Injected once when the permission mode drifts from the baseline, so the model knows which mode it is in.

description.zh: 进入与退出 swarm 模式时各注入一次。
description.en: Injected once on entering swarm mode and once on leaving it.

description.zh: 会话生命周期与补丁：创建/恢复/分叉、session patch、SQLite 存储与标题生成。
description.en: Session lifecycle and patching: create/resume/fork, session patch, SQLite store, title generation.

description.zh: 会话持久化：SQLite 存储、JSON patch 应用与存储路径。
description.en: Session persistence: the SQLite store, JSON patch application and storage paths.

description.zh: AI 会话标题：生成与持久化。

description.zh: 子代理编排：manager、fork、persistent/secondary 代理与 btw 侧信道。

description.zh: 回合状态机：run_turn、step 调度、重试、tool-call id 账本与墙钟预算。
description.en: The turn state machine: run_turn, step scheduler, retry, tool-call id ledger and wall-time budget.

description.zh: 模型协议适配：Anthropic、OpenAI Responses、Google GenAI 与共享 HTTP 层。
description.en: Model protocol adapters: Anthropic, OpenAI Responses, Google GenAI and the shared HTTP layer.

description.zh: Anthropic Messages 协议适配：请求整形、thinking 透传与流式映射。

description.zh: Google GenAI 适配：Gemini 模型的请求与流式映射。

description.zh: 共享 HTTP 管线：传输、代理、wire 类型、计时、媒体预算/解析与 thinking 守卫。

description.zh: OpenAI 系适配：Chat Completions 与 Responses API。

label.zh: 运行时按 key 取词条

reading.zh: 顶层按数据流阅读：用户对话的应用 → 它驱动的 SDK 边界 → 背后的 Rust 引擎 → 双方复用的共享库 → 守护仓库质量的工具链。
reading.en: Top level, data-flow order: the app the user talks to, the SDK seam it drives, the Rust engine behind it, the shared libraries both sides reuse, and the tooling that keeps the repo honest.

reading.zh: CLI 是主产品，放最前；随后是可视化两件套、编辑器集成与文档站。
reading.en: CLI first: it is the product everything else serves. Then the visualization surfaces, editor integration and the docs site.

reading.zh: 外壳与管线：交互 TUI 在上，命令解析在下。
reading.en: Shell and plumbing: the interactive TUI on top, the command parser underneath.

reading.zh: 外壳包裹面板。
reading.en: Shell wraps the panels.

reading.zh: 按下钻顺序排列：发生了什么 → 批准了什么 → 线上传输了什么。
reading.en: Human-readable views in drill order: what happened, what was approved, what was said on the wire.

reading.zh: 引擎分层：回合循环居中，工具与模型传输环绕，MCP 侧翼，随后是宿主面（服务器、插件注册表）与 JS 边界。
reading.en: Engine layers: the turn loop at the center, its tools and model transports around it, MCP on the side, then the hosting surface (server, plugin registry) and the JS boundary last.

reading.zh: 运行时回路：回合居中，注入在步首改写上下文，会话环绕，子代理在下，压缩是内存压力阀。
reading.en: The runtime loop: turns at the center, injections rewrite the context at each step head, sessions around them, subagents below, compaction as the memory pressure valve.

reading.zh: 四个注入器按触发时机分三档：目标与计划是节奏驱动的常驻提醒，权限模式与 Swarm 只在状态跃迁时打一次标记，中断提醒是上一回合留下的回声。
reading.en: Four injectors in three cadence classes: goal and plan are rhythm-driven standing reminders, permission-mode and swarm fire a one-shot marker only on a state transition, and the interruption reminder is the echo left by the previous turn.

reading.zh: 存储在底，标题在上。
reading.en: Storage underneath, titles on top.

reading.zh: 每个协议族一个适配器，共享 HTTP 管线作公共底座。
reading.en: One adapter per protocol family, with the shared HTTP plumbing as the common base.

reading.zh: 管理器管注册表与生命周期；客户端管传输。
reading.en: The manager owns the registry and lifecycle; clients own the transports.

reading.zh: 导出与其类型镜像并排。
reading.en: Exports and their type mirror, kept side by side.

reading.zh: 状态在前（SQLite 注册表），获取在后（远程归档）。
reading.en: State first (the SQLite registry), acquisition second (remote archives).

reading.zh: 两扇门一本账：REST 进、WS 出，底下是转录投影。
reading.en: Two doors and a ledger: REST in, WS out, the transcript projection underneath.

reading.zh: 基础工具（文件与 shell）在前，随后是 agent 编排、协作、知识与网络。
reading.en: Basics first (file & shell), then agent orchestration, collaboration, knowledge, and the web.

reading.zh: 按职责分组：界面（TUI、i18n 三件套）、能力（normify、认证）、数据（遥测、转录、MiniDb）与语言基础（kaos、bash 解析）。从左上起按这个顺序读。
reading.en: Four groups by concern: interface (TUI, the i18n trio), capability (normify, auth), data (telemetry, transcript, minidb) and language foundations (kaos, bash parser).

reading.zh: 适配层在上（工具、MCP、CLI），确定性内核在下。
reading.en: Adapters on top (tools, MCP, CLI), the deterministic kernel underneath.

reading.zh: 边界层：宿主直接调用的 SDK、共享线上协议 schema，以及底层的 LLM 抽象。
reading.en: The seam: the concrete SDK the host calls, the shared wire schemas, and the LLM abstraction underneath.

reading.zh: 门面在前：调用者只见 harness；底下的原生客户端走 napi。
reading.en: Facade first: callers see the harness; the native client underneath talks napi.

reading.zh: 先门禁后构建：质量检查在前，打包机制在后。
reading.en: Gates before build: quality checks first, then the packaging machinery.
